title: Gyudon (Japanese Simmered Beef and Rice Bowls)
description: Gyudon is a Japanese beef and onion rice bowl simmered in a savory-sweet sauce of soy, sake, and dashi. Quick, comforting, and deeply flavorful.

steps.instruction: Combine onion, dashi, sake, soy sauce, and sugar in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Cook until onions soften, about 5 minutes.
Add beef and cook until fully cooked and liquid reduces into a rich sauce, about 5 minutes.
Stir in grated ginger and simmer for 1 more minute.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt or sugar if needed.
Divide rice into bowls and top with beef mixture.
Garnish with scallions, beni shoga, togarashi, and optional poached egg. Serve immediately.
